array_methods.title: push(e1,e2,...)
array_methods.description: Adds one or more elements to the end of an array

array_methods.title: pop()
array_methods.description: Removes the last element from an array

array_methods.title: shift()
array_methods.description: Removes the first element from an array

array_methods.title: unshift(e1,e2,...)
array_methods.description: Adds one or more elements to the beginning of an array

array_methods.title: reverse()
array_methods.description: Reverses the order of the elements in an array
